messages:
Samir (AE): CharterPay POC kickoff 3/14. Need streaming + function/tool calls + stable JSON schema for tx normalization. Can we assemble SDK snippets, a handshake runbook, security answers, and a pricing ballpark?
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll do Go/Python SDK examples and a small Node snippet showing function-call handling and schema parsing. Will include JSON Schema for tx_normalized.
Oliver K.: Streaming recommendation: SSE or chunked frames. Use an event envelope with event type and base64 payload if you need atomic JSON per chunk. I'll draft reconnection/backpressure guidance.
Tara L. (Security): Send the questionnaire. Quick answers: SOC2 yes; customer-managed KMS in Dedicated/Private; EU data residency supported; audit logs with configurable retention. I'll prepare formal wording.
Samir (AE): Pricing ask: expected 100k tokens/day steady, spikes to 300k. Need hosted vs dedicated roughs for SOW.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Ballpark hosted gen ~$0.0008/token (model dependent). Dedicated reserved nodes can cut unit costs ~35-50% with commit. I'll include caveats about quantization.
deploy-bot: Runbook template created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/charterpay-poc (sales,solutions access).
Samir (AE): Can we have runbook + snippets + security blurb + pricing by EOD tomorrow? Client tech sync 3/15.
Oliver K.: Adding appendix: batching tips, KV-cache reuse for latency/cost savings, and fallback to smaller quantized model variants for availability.
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll post the draft bundle to the deal folder and include a tiny test harness that validates the schema and simulates load.
Tara L. (Security): I'll request pen-test summary from SecOps preemptively and upload responses to the Deal folder when ready.
Samir (AE): Thanks everyone. If SSO cert rotation or ephemeral-creds for streaming are blockers, flag here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
